INSERT INTO t_prompt (id, user_id, source_id, prompt_key, title, prompt, description, cover_url, reference_image_urls, tags_json, preview, author, source_url, image_mode, image_model, image_size, image_count, sort_index, remote_created_at, remote_updated_at, created_at) VALUES
(#{p.id}, #{p.userId}, #{p.sourceId}, #{p.promptKey}, #{p.title}, #{p.prompt}, #{p.description}, #{p.coverUrl}, #{p.referenceImageUrls}, #{p.tagsJson}, #{p.preview}, #{p.author}, #{p.sourceUrl}, #{p.imageMode}, #{p.imageModel}, #{p.imageSize}, #{p.imageCount}, #{p.sortIndex}, #{p.remoteCreatedAt}, #{p.remoteUpdatedAt}, NOW())
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = new.title, prompt = new.prompt, description = new.description, cover_url = new.cover_url, reference_image_urls = new.reference_image_urls, tags_json = new.tags_json, preview = new.preview, author = new.author, source_url = new.source_url, image_mode = new.image_mode, image_model = new.image_model, image_size = new.image_size, image_count = new.image_count, sort_index = new.sort_index, remote_created_at = new.remote_created_at, remote_updated_at = new.remote_updated_at
